reason: Verification failed on major spec-alignment issues: missing required metrics (voluntary_vs_mandatory_share, policy_violations_count), a restock-rate logic bug that can disable restocking, and mis-aggregated metrics. With 3 iterations remaining, a targeted pass can realistically fix these and bring the simulation to spec compliance.

specific_areas: Implement voluntary_vs_mandatory_share via within-step counterfactual adoption probabilities (with vs without penalty influence) and expose daily and mean values.
Track and report policy_violations_count explicitly (penalties_today_count + denied_access_today) as daily series and total.
Fix restock-rate handling: interpret fractional retailer_restock_rate (0 < rate <= 1.0) as fraction of population per day; treat >1.0 as absolute units; avoid premature int() casts.
Time-average adoption_by_location_type across the simulation and optionally expose the daily series.
Add overall_adoption_rate_mean alongside the per-timestep series.

Extend evaluate() to return all plan metrics: time_to_target_adoption, adoption_by_location_type (time-averaged and/or daily), voluntary_vs_mandatory_share, adoption_inequality_index, policy_violations_count, mask_access_shortages.
Separate shortage accounting into unmet_demand (affordability + availability) vs retailer stockouts; track stockout days and unmet demand fraction.
Parameter/entity alignment: use mask_availability for initial stock, income_mean/std for income draws; optionally map/alias Retailer/MediaChannel naming in outputs.
Add regression tests: fractional restock-rate nonzero restocking; presence and naming of required metrics; counterfactual computation does not mutate state; evaluate() returns all required keys.

task_understanding.adjustments: Adopt a strict spec-to-implementation checklist with required metric names, definitions, and aggregation methods; include acceptance criteria for each metric before marking complete.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan and validate counterfactual computations for voluntary vs mandatory shares; define clear formulas for stockout vs unmet demand, and ensure daily and aggregate forms are consistent.

model_planning.adjustments: Design step-level hooks to compute counterfactual adoption without modifying agent state; define restock logic semantics for fractional rates; document how location-type averaging is performed.

code_generation.adjustments: Avoid premature type casting on parameters; implement new metrics with minimal intrusion; ensure evaluate() surfaces correctly named outputs; add docstrings and inline comments for new logic.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit tests for fractional restocking, policy_violations_count accumulation, voluntary/mandatory decomposition, and evaluate() output schema; include a quick lint/type check in CI.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke tests across parameter sets (e.g., retailer_restock_rate = 0.1 and 500), with/without mandates, to validate metrics and performance; record seeds for reproducibility.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and verify time_to_target_adoption; cross-check inequality indices; verify that adoption_by_location_type is time-averaged; confirm mask_access_shortages components behave sensibly.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Produce concise, prioritized change logs tied to spec gaps; include before/after examples for critical fixes (restock-rate, new metrics) and note any assumptions or limitations.
